name: GY94_ext
title: An extended version of the Goldman & Yang (1994) model of dN/dS

args.name: omega
args.description: Rate multiplier for nonsynonymous substitutions relative to synonymous substitutions

description: This is a version of the GY94 model extended to use a user-supplied nucleotide exchangeability matrix nucModel. GY94 distinguishes only transitions and transversions and is equivalent to GY94_ext(HKY85_sym). Rates are proportional to the destination codon frequency and are multiplied by omega for nonsynonymous changes.

citation.title: A codon-based model of nucleotide substitution for protein-coding DNA sequences
